title: Show what an empty apartment could be
description: Virtual staging for a sale or rental listing. Furniture appears in the photo of an empty room, while the windows, doors, view and layout stay as they are.

blocks.text: An empty apartment is hard to picture furnished, so a listing may need some furnishing options. But altered windows, view and layout already show a different property. In one review it is precisely the distorted background that makes the result unusable.

quote.text: if you’re looking for an app to do virtual staging for MLS listings this isn’t it. It screws up the background of the photos. It blurs trees, adds houses, and general AI slop.

blocks.text: Add furniture to the original photograph, leaving the elements of the space and the background beyond the windows untouched. Offer a comparison with the original and label the staging as virtual. Save separate versions of the rooms in one property, so they can be shown one after another.

Test one property together with the person preparing the listing. Have them mark every change outside the furniture. The value of this processing is a clear picture of how the place could be furnished; any effect on how fast or how high it sells does not follow from the reviews cited here.
